description:
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it, preventing half the damage done to you by a single source, rounded down.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Dark Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast Dark Sphere from the top of your library by paying 0 life through Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.
